Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: Mind the casks. Father wants every horn polished before the thing, and half the mead got rained on carrying it up the cliff stairs.

Choices.Text: Let me carry the rest up for you.
Your father seems afraid of something.
Tell me what he's hiding. Now.

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: You're kinder than your reputation, raven. Come find me after; I'll pour you the first of the dry mead.

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: Afraid? He's the lawspeaker. He's never afraid. He just... hasn't slept since the merchant from Hedeby came.

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: I don't know anything! Leave me be, or I'll call the hall-guard!

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: I can't keep it in. Last night I saw Father with a little clay vial, the one the Hedeby merchant gave him. He wept over the oath-horn. Bjorn, what is he going to do?

Choices.Text: Nothing, if I can help it. Will you say this before the jarls, if it comes to that?
Say nothing to anyone. I'll handle it quietly.

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: If it saves Father from worse... yes. Gods forgive me, yes.

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: Quietly. Promise me quietly doesn't mean the fjord.

Nodes.Speaker: NPC
Nodes.Line: They say the storm took him. I know better. I saw your face in the lightning, raven. One day I will see it again, at the end of my knife.
